national_questions.qe: What is the name of the AI‑based tool launched by SEBI to detect financial fraud on social media?
national_questions.qh: वित्तीय धोखाधड़ी का पता लगाने के लिए सेबी द्वारा लॉन्च किए गए एआई‑आधारित टूल का नाम क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because SEBI announced the AI tool named ‘Sudarshan’ for multi‑stage fraud detection.
• Option A is Incorrect; ‘Suraksha’ is not the name of the tool.
• Option C is Incorrect; ‘Samved’ is unrelated to SEBI’s AI initiative.
• Option D is Incorrect; ‘Sanchalak’ is not the tool launched by SEBI.

national_questions.qe: Which of the following projects was NOT inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi at Ekta Nagar on Rashtriya Ekta Diwas?
national_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय एकता दिवस पर प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी द्वारा एकता नगर में किस परियोजना का उद्घाटन नहीं किया गया?
oe: Artificial Rain Forest with a circular glass skywalk
oh: वृत्ताकार कांच के स्काईवॉक के साथ कृत्रिम रेन फॉरेस्ट
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because a new metro line was not among the projects listed for inauguration.
• Option A is Incorrect; the 12‑acre artificial Rain Forest with glass skywalk was inaugurated.
• Option B is Incorrect; Vaman Vriksha Vatika was part of the inaugurated projects.
• Option D is Incorrect; Ekta Cruise was also inaugurated at the event.

national_questions.qe: Where is India’s first indigenous high‑speed bullet train set “B28” being manufactured?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला स्वदेशी हाई‑स्पीड बुलेट ट्रेन सेट “B28” कहाँ निर्मित हो रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the B28 set is being built at BEML’s Bengaluru workshop in collaboration with ICF.
• Option A is Incorrect because ICF is only a partner for design and testing, not the primary manufacturing site.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Rail Coach Factory, Kapurthala manufactures conventional coaches, not the bullet‑train set.
• Option D is Incorrect because Alstom does not have a manufacturing unit for the indigenous B28 project.

national_questions.qe: Which former Central Vigilance Commissioner was appointed chairperson of the High‑Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat?
national_questions.qh: विकसित भारत के लिए बैंकिंग पर हाई‑लेवल कमेटी के चेयरपर्सन के रूप में किस पूर्व केंद्रीय सतर्कता आयुक्त को नियुक्त किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the committee was chaired by former CVC Suresh N. Patel.
• Option B is Incorrect; Raghuram Rajan is a former RBI Governor, not appointed to this committee.
• Option C is Incorrect; Urjit Patel is also a former RBI Governor, not the chair.
• Option D is Incorrect; Shaktikanta Das is the current RBI Governor, not a committee member.

national_questions.qe: What was the amount of the additional advance tax devolution released by the Union Finance Ministry to states on 31 October 2026?
national_questions.qh: 31 अक्टूबर 2026 को केंद्र वित्त मंत्रालय द्वारा राज्यों को जारी किए गए अतिरिक्त अग्रिम कर हस्तांतरण की राशि क्या थी?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Ministry released an additional ₹1,09,019 crore on the stated date.
• Option A is Incorrect; ₹85,000 crore does not match the announced figure.
• Option C is Incorrect; ₹1,25,500 crore exceeds the actual amount.
• Option D is Incorrect; ₹95,750 crore is not the amount disclosed.

national_questions.qe: What is the name of the insecticide molecule that is India’s first indigenously discovered and commercialised as Pioxazon?
national_questions.qh: भारत में पहली बार स्वदेशी रूप से खोजी गई और पियोक्साज़ोन के रूप में व्यावसायीकरण की गई कीटाणुनाशक अणु का नाम क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Pioxaniliprole is the first insecticide molecule discovered in India and launched commercially as Pioxazon for rice, maize and Bengal gram.
• Option B is Incorrect because Chlorpyrifos is an imported insecticide, not an indigenous discovery.
• Option C is Incorrect because Imidacloprid is a synthetic insecticide developed abroad.
• Option D is Incorrect because Cypermethrin is a widely used synthetic insecticide, not the first Indian‑discovered molecule.

national_questions.qe: Under which central scheme was Khaira village in Chhattisgarh declared India’s first 100% solar village?
national_questions.qh: छत्तीसगढ़ के खैरा गांव को भारत का पहला 100% सौर गांव घोषित करने के लिए कौन सी केंद्रीय योजना लागू की गई?
oe: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana
oh: दीन दयाल उपाध्याय ग्राम ज्योति योजना
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Khaira village achieved 100% rooftop solar coverage under the PM Surya Ghar Yojana (Muft Bijli Yojana).
• Option A is Incorrect as Saubhagya focuses on household electrification, not solar rooftop deployment.
• Option C is Incorrect; Ujjwal Bharat is a broader rural electrification program.
• Option D is Incorrect; Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Gram Jyoti Yojana deals with power supply to villages, not solar installations.

national_questions.qe: Which state government signed an MoU with Ion Beam Applications SA subsidiary to set up India’s first public proton beam therapy centre?
national_questions.qh: कौन सी राज्य सरकार ने आयन बीम एप्लिकेशन्स SA की सहायक कंपनी के साथ भारत के पहले सार्वजनिक प्रोटॉन बीम थेरेपी केंद्र की स्थापना के लिए समझौता ज्ञापन (MoU) पर हस्ताक्षर किए?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Assam government signed the MoU with Ion Beam Applications SA subsidiary for a Rs 600 crore public proton beam therapy unit in Guwahati.
• Option A is Incorrect; Kerala has not announced such a MoU.
• Option B is Incorrect; Maharashtra’s initiatives are unrelated to this specific public proton therapy project.
• Option D is Incorrect; Tamil Nadu has private proton therapy centres but no public MoU of this nature.

national_questions.qe: By which target year has the Union Ministry of Home Affairs planned to establish Foreigners Regional Registration Offices (FRROs) across all state capitals in India?
national_questions.qh: केंद्रीय गृह मंत्रालय ने भारत के सभी राज्यों की राजधानियों में विदेशी क्षेत्रीय पंजीकरण कार्यालय (FRRO) स्थापित करने का लक्ष्य किस वर्ष तक निर्धारित किया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Union Home Minister Amit Shah directed the establishment of Foreigners Regional Registration Offices (FRROs) in all state capitals across India by 2027 to manage post-arrival tracking, visa extensions, and consular oversight.
• Option A is Incorrect because 2025 is not the target year set by the MHA.
• Option C is Incorrect because 2030 is beyond the established policy roadmap.
• Option D is Incorrect because 2028 is not the official timeline set for expanding FRRO coverage.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian state has become the first in the country to procure 24 agricultural crops at the Minimum Support Price (MSP)?
national_questions.qh: न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य (MSP) पर 24 कृषि फसलों की खरीद करने वाला भारत का पहला राज्य कौन सा बन गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because Haryana became the first state in India to procure 24 crops at the Minimum Support Price (MSP), as highlighted during the 60th Haryana Day celebrations.
• Option A is Incorrect because Punjab primarily procures staple grains like wheat and paddy under central MSP allocations.
• Option B is Incorrect because Madhya Pradesh introduced price deficiency payment systems like Bhavantar Bhugtan Yojna rather than full MSP procurement of 24 crops.
• Option C is Incorrect because Uttar Pradesh does not procure 24 distinct agricultural crops at MSP.

national_questions.qe: Which public sector manufacturing company is producing India's first indigenously designed high-speed bullet train trainset, designated as 'B28'?
national_questions.qh: भारत के पहले स्वदेशी रूप से डिजाइन किए गए हाई-स्पीड बुलेट ट्रेन ट्रेनसेट, जिसे 'B28' नाम दिया गया है, का निर्माण किस सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र की निर्माण कंपनी द्वारा किया जा रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because India's first indigenously designed high-speed bullet train trainset (designated as B28) is being manufactured by BEML at its facility in Bengaluru for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail corridor.
• Option B is Incorrect because BHEL is a major heavy electrical equipment manufacturer and is not manufacturing the B28 high-speed trainset.
• Option C is Incorrect because HAL specializes in aerospace and defense manufacturing.
• Option D is Incorrect because Titagarh Rail Systems manufactures metro coaches and freight wagons, whereas BEML Bengaluru was selected for the B28 bullet train trainset.

national_questions.qe: Who won India's first-ever medal in swimming at the Youth Olympic Games by securing a bronze in the girls' 100-metre freestyle event?
national_questions.qh: युवा ओलंपिक खेलों में लड़कियों की 100 मीटर फ्रीस्टाइल स्पर्धा में कांस्य पदक जीतकर तैराकी में भारत का पहला पदक किसने जीता?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because swimmer Dhinidhi Desinghu made history by winning India's first-ever Youth Olympic Games swimming medal, securing a bronze in the girls' 100m freestyle at Dakar 2026 with a time of 56.27 seconds.
• Option A is Incorrect because Maana Patel is an Olympic backstroke swimmer, not the Youth Olympic bronze medalist.
• Option C is Incorrect because Srihari Nataraj is a prominent male Olympic swimmer from India.
• Option D is Incorrect because Shivani Kataria represented India at the 2016 Rio Olympics in women's freestyle swimming.

national_questions.qe: At which location is NTPC setting up India's first ceramic-based concentrated solar power (CSP) project designed to store heat and generate power at night?
national_questions.qh: NTPC किस स्थान पर ऊष्मा को संग्रहीत करने और रात में बिजली उत्पन्न करने के लिए डिज़ाइन की गई भारत की पहली सिरेमिक-आधारित संकेंद्रित सौर ऊर्जा (CSP) परियोजना स्थापित कर रहा है?
oe: Kurnool Ultra Mega Solar Park, Andhra Pradesh
oh: कुरनूल अल्ट्रा मेगा सोलर पार्क, आंध्र प्रदेश
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because NTPC is setting up India's first 320 kW ceramic-based concentrated solar power (CSP) pilot project at Bhadla Solar Park in Rajasthan using high-temperature ceramic modules to generate electricity during the night.
• Option A is Incorrect because Pavagada Solar Park is located in Tumakuru district, Karnataka, and is not the host location for this pilot project.
• Option B is Incorrect because Charanka Solar Park is situated in Gujarat.
• Option D is Incorrect because Kurnool Ultra Mega Solar Park is located in Andhra Pradesh.

national_questions.qe: Where is India's first public-sector Proton Therapy Centre for advanced cancer treatment being established?
national_questions.qh: उन्नत कैंसर उपचार के लिए भारत का पहला सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र का प्रोटॉन थेरेपी केंद्र कहाँ स्थापित किया जा रहा है?
oe: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi
Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER), Chandigarh
Gauhati Medical College and Hospital (GMCH), Assam
oh: अखिल भारतीय आयुर्विज्ञान संस्थान (AIIMS), नई दिल्ली
स्नातकोत्तर चिकित्सा शिक्षा एवं अनुसंधान संस्थान (PGIMER), चंडीगढ़
गुवाहाटी मेडिकल कॉलेज एवं अस्पताल (GMCH), असम
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because India's first public-sector Proton Therapy Centre is being established at Gauhati Medical College and Hospital (GMCH) in Assam at a total project cost of ₹600 crore under the World Bank-assisted ASSIST initiative.
• Option A is Incorrect because AIIMS New Delhi is a premier medical institution, but is not establishing India's first government proton therapy centre under this project.
• Option B is Incorrect because Tata Memorial Hospital in Mumbai is a comprehensive cancer centre, but the first public-sector proton therapy facility is being set up at GMCH Guwahati.
• Option C is Incorrect because PGIMER Chandigarh is a major tertiary institute in North India, not the location for this proton beam facility.

national_questions.qe: In which neighboring country is the 'Gelephu Mindfulness City' project located, where 108 Stupas were recently consecrated along the Aie (Mau) River?
national_questions.qh: किस पड़ोसी देश में 'गेलेफू माइंडफुलनेस सिटी' परियोजना स्थित है, जहाँ हाल ही में ऐ (माउ) नदी के किनारे 108 स्तूपों का प्राण-प्रतिष्ठापन किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the King of Bhutan dedicated Stupa number 76 to Prime Minister Narendra Modi during the consecration of 108 Stupas in Gelephu Mindfulness City along the Aie (Mau) River in Bhutan.
• Option A is Incorrect because Nepal is not the host nation for the Gelephu Mindfulness City project.
• Option B is Incorrect because Sri Lanka is an island nation in the Indian Ocean, unrelated to Gelephu.
• Option C is Incorrect because Myanmar shares eastern borders with India and is not involved in the Gelephu initiative.

national_questions.qe: Which international grouping is negotiating a Comprehensive Free Trade Agreement (FTA) with India, targeting full entry into force by mid-2027?
national_questions.qh: किस अंतर्राष्ट्रीय समूह के साथ भारत एक व्यापक मुक्त व्यापार समझौते (FTA) पर बातचीत कर रहा है, जिसे मध्य-2027 तक लागू करने का लक्ष्य रखा गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because high-level trade discussions were held in Brussels between India and the European Union (EU) to review FTA implementation, targeted for entry into force by mid-2027.
• Option B is Incorrect because ASEAN already signed an FTA with India in 2009.
• Option C is Incorrect because GCC trade negotiations are a separate initiative.
• Option D is Incorrect because the African Union is a continental bloc not engaged in these specific bilateral FTA talks.

national_questions.qe: India's first indigenous hydrogen-powered train has been launched on which railway section of Northern Railway?
national_questions.qh: उत्तर रेलवे के किस रेलवे खंड पर भारत की पहली स्वदेशी हाइड्रोजन-संचालित ट्रेन शुरू की गई है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because India's first indigenous hydrogen-powered train operates on the Jind–Sonipat section in Haryana under Northern Railway, utilizing a Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell.
• Option A is Incorrect because Kalka–Shimla is a narrow-gauge heritage route.
• Option C is Incorrect because Darjeeling Himalayan Railway is a UNESCO site using traditional steam/diesel engines.
• Option D is Incorrect because Nilgiri Mountain Railway is located in Tamil Nadu.

national_questions.qe: Which Union Ministry is the nodal agency conducting India's first fully digital population count under Census 2026?
national_questions.qh: जनगणना 2026 के तहत भारत की पहली पूर्णतः डिजिटल जनसंख्या गणना आयोजित करने के लिए कौन सा केंद्रीय मंत्रालय नोडल एजेंसी है?
oe: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India operates under the Ministry of Home Affairs, which conducts the digital Census 2026.
• Option A is Incorrect because MoSPI handles NSO sample surveys, not the decennial census.
• Option B is Incorrect because MeitY provides general IT framework support but is not the executive agency.
• Option D is Incorrect because Housing and Urban Affairs deals strictly with urban governance and housing policies.

national_questions.qe: Which Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) is manufacturing India's first indigenous high-speed bullet train (B28) at its Aditya Plant in Bengaluru?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र का उपक्रम (PSU) बेंगलुरु स्थित अपने आदित्य संयंत्र में भारत की पहली स्वदेशी हाई-स्पीड बुलेट ट्रेन (B28) का निर्माण कर रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because BEML (Bharat Earth Movers Limited) is manufacturing India's first indigenous bullet train (B28) at its Aditya Plant in Bengaluru for the Mumbai–Ahmedabad corridor.
• Option A is Incorrect because BHEL manufactures heavy electrical equipment and locomotives but not the B28 bullet train.
• Option B is Incorrect because ICF Chennai manufactures Vande Bharat express trains.
• Option C is Incorrect because HAL is an aerospace defense PSU.

national_questions.qe: Which two Indian public‑sector units are jointly constructing the body frame of India’s first indigenous bullet train (B28)?
national_questions.qh: भारत की पहली स्वदेशी बुलेट ट्रेन (B28) के बॉडी फ्रेम का निर्माण करने वाले दो भारतीय सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के इकाइयों का नाम क्या है?
oe: ICF and Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)
oh: ICF और भारतीय अंतरिक्ष अनुसंधान संगठन (ISRO)
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the bullet‑train (B28) body frame is being built jointly by Integral Coach Factory, Chennai and BEML, Bengaluru, as per the official project update.
• Option B is Incorrect; Indian Railways is the operator and DRDO is not a manufacturing partner for the train body.
• Option C is Incorrect; HAL works on aerospace projects, not high‑speed rail bodies.
• Option D is Incorrect; ISRO is not involved in rail‑coach manufacturing.

national_questions.qe: When is the first operational section (Surat–Vapi) of the Mumbai‑Ahmedabad High‑Speed Rail corridor scheduled to be inaugurated?
national_questions.qh: मुंबई‑अहमदाबाद हाई‑स्पीड रेल कॉरिडोर के पहले परिचालन खंड (सूरत‑वापी) का उद्घाटन कब निर्धारित है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because official project reports state that the Surat–Vapi section will be opened to traffic in August 2027.
• Option A is Incorrect; no official timeline places the inauguration in December 2026.
• Option C is Incorrect; the projected date is earlier than March 2028.
• Option D is Incorrect; June 2027 is not the announced month for the first section’s opening.

national_questions.qe: Which initiative was highlighted by the Union Defence Minister during the third Delhi Defence Dialogue?
national_questions.qh: तीसरे दिल्ली डिफेंस डायलॉग के दौरान केंद्रीय रक्षा मंत्री द्वारा किस पहल को प्रमुखता दी गई?
oe: Corporatisation of the Ordnance Factory Board into seven Defence PSUs
Launch of an indigenous fighter jet
Establishment of a new naval base on the east coast
oh: ऑर्डनेंस फ़ैक्टरी बोर्ड का सात रक्षा पीएसयू में निगमित होना
पूर्वी तट पर नया नौसैनिक अड्डा स्थापित करना
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because the Defence Industrial Corridors were mentioned but not the sole highlighted initiative.
• Option B is Correct because the Minister specifically highlighted the corporatisation of the Ordnance Factory Board into seven Defence PSUs.
• Option C is Incorrect as no launch of a new indigenous fighter jet was announced.
• Option D is Incorrect; no new naval base was part of the dialogue.

national_questions.qe: What was the theme of the Indo‑Pacific Regional Dialogue 2026 held in New Delhi?
national_questions.qh: न्यू दिल्ली में आयोजित इन्डो‑पैसिफिक रीजनल डायलॉग 2026 का थीम क्या था?
oe: Science, Technology and Academic Cooperation in the Indo‑Pacific
Maritime Security and Trade in the Indo‑Pacific
Climate Change and Blue Economy in the Indo‑Pacific
oh: इन्डो‑पैसिफिक में विज्ञान, प्रौद्योगिकी और शैक्षणिक सहयोग
इन्डो‑पैसिफिक में समुद्री सुरक्षा और व्यापार
इन्डो‑पैसिफिक में जलवायु परिवर्तन और ब्लू इकोनॉमी
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the official theme was “Science, Technology and Academic Cooperation in the Indo‑Pacific”.
• Option B is Incorrect; maritime security was discussed but not the declared theme.
• Option C is Incorrect; climate change was a sub‑topic, not the main theme.
• Option D is Incorrect; cybersecurity was not the headline theme.

national_questions.qe: What percentage of the energy requirement for Pune Metro Line 3 is planned to be sourced from solar power?
national_questions.qh: पुणे मेट्रो लाइन 3 की ऊर्जा आवश्यकता का कितना प्रतिशत सौर ऊर्जा से प्राप्त किया जाएगा?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Incorrect because the plan is for a higher share than 10 %.
• Option B is Incorrect; 20 % is not the announced figure.
• Option C is Correct as the project will source 30 % of its energy from solar power.
• Option D is Incorrect; 40 % exceeds the stated target.

national_questions.qe: What are the new operating hours of the NSE International Exchange at GIFT City after the recent extension?
national_questions.qh: विस्तार के बाद GIFT सिटी में NSE इंटरनेशनल एक्सचेंज के नए संचालन समय क्या हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the exchange now operates from 3:15 AM to 2:45 AM IST, covering almost a full 24‑hour cycle.
• Option B is Incorrect; the start time is earlier than 5:15 AM.
• Option C is Incorrect; the closing time is later than 5:15 PM.
• Option D is Incorrect; there is a short maintenance window, not a strict 24‑hour continuous run.

national_questions.qe: Under which ministry was the Bengaluru‑Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper train flagged off?
national_questions.qh: बेंगलुरु‑मुंबई वंदे भारत स्लीपर ट्रेन को किस मंत्रालय के तहत ध्वजांकित किया गया?
oe: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
oh: गृह एवं शहरी मामलों का मंत्रालय
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the train was flagged off by Union Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw and belongs to the Ministry of Railways.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways deals with highways, not railway services.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ministry of Commerce and Industry is unrelated to passenger train operations.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs does not oversee railway projects.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian state launched the first Silt Management Policy in 2026?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा भारतीय राज्य 2026 में पहला सिल्ट प्रबंधन नीति लॉन्च किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Bihar introduced the Bihar Water Source Restoration and Silt Management Policy 2026, the first such policy in India.
• Option A is Incorrect; Uttar Pradesh has not announced a dedicated silt‑management policy.
• Option C is Incorrect; Maharashtra’s recent initiatives relate to road safety, not silt management.
• Option D is Incorrect; Gujarat has not released a comparable state‑wide silt policy.

national_questions.qe: What is the passenger capacity of India’s first indigenous high‑speed bullet train?
national_questions.qh: भारत के पहले स्वदेशी हाई‑स्पीड बुलेट ट्रेन की यात्री क्षमता कितनी है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the eight‑coach indigenous bullet train built by BEML will carry 557 passengers.
• Option A is Incorrect; 400 is lower than the announced capacity.
• Option B is Incorrect; 600 exceeds the official figure.
• Option D is Incorrect; 720 is not mentioned in any official release.

national_questions.qe: In which location of Maharashtra will the country's first Road Safety Training and Research Institute be established?
national_questions.qh: महाराष्ट्र में भारत का पहला रोड सुरक्षा प्रशिक्षण एवं अनुसंधान संस्थान किस स्थान पर स्थापित होगा?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the institute is planned at Saswad in Pune district.
• Option A is Incorrect; while Pune district hosts the project, the specific town is Saswad.
• Option B is Incorrect; Nagpur is not mentioned in the announcement.
• Option C is Incorrect; Nashik is unrelated to this initiative.

national_questions.qe: What is the total grid-scale energy storage capacity targeted for development by 2030–31 under the Viability Gap Funding scheme approved by the Union Cabinet?
national_questions.qh: केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल द्वारा स्वीकृत वायबिलिटी गैप फंडिंग (VGF) योजना के तहत वर्ष 2030-31 तक कुल कितनी ग्रिड-स्तरीय ऊर्जा भंडारण क्षमता के विकास का लक्ष्य रखा गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Union Cabinet approved a ₹14,500 crore VGF scheme to develop 92 GWh of grid-scale energy storage capacity by 2030–31 (comprising 60 GWh pumped hydro, 30 GWh battery storage, and 2 GWh emerging tech).
• Option A is Incorrect because 50 GWh does not reflect the total target allocated under the scheme.
• Option B is Incorrect because 75 GWh is less than the approved 92 GWh target.
• Option D is Incorrect because 110 GWh exceeds the approved capacity target.

national_questions.qe: Which premier institution under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports launched the Extramural Research Grant Policy to advance anti-doping research in India?
national_questions.qh: भारत में डोपिंग रोधी अनुसंधान को बढ़ावा देने के लिए युवा कार्यक्रम और खेल मंत्रालय के तहत किस प्रमुख संस्थान ने 'एक्स्ट्राम्यूरल्स रिसर्च ग्रांट पॉलिसी' शुरू की है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Extramural Research Grant Policy was launched by the National Dope Testing Laboratory (NDTL) during the 10th WAADS meeting in New Delhi.
• Option A is Incorrect because SAI manages sports infrastructure and athlete development, not specialized dope testing research grants.
• Option B is Incorrect because NADA handles anti-doping rule enforcement and testing execution, whereas NDTL manages testing laboratory research.
• Option C is Incorrect because the IOA is an administrative governing body for Olympic sports in India.

national_questions.qe: Where is India's first indigenously designed and manufactured high-speed bullet trainset being developed for the Mumbai–Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail corridor?
national_questions.qh: मुंबई-अहमदाबाद हाई-स्पीड रेल कॉरिडोर के लिए भारत की पहली स्वदेशी रूप से डिजाइन और निर्मित बुलेट ट्रेन का निर्माण कहाँ किया जा रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because India's first indigenously designed and manufactured bullet trainset is being built at BEML's Bengaluru facility for the Mumbai–Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail corridor. The 8-coach trainset is 202 meters long with a design operational speed of 249 km/h.
• Option A is Incorrect because ICF Chennai primarily produces Vande Bharat Express trainsets, not the indigenous bullet train.
• Option C is Incorrect because RCF Kapurthala produces standard LHB coaches and conventional rake variants.
• Option D is Incorrect because MCF Raebareli manufactures conventional passenger coaches and smart coaches.

national_questions.qe: In which city is India's first urban public transport ropeway project being constructed to connect the main railway station with Godowlia Chowk?
national_questions.qh: मुख्य रेलवे स्टेशन को गोदौलिया चौक से जोड़ने के लिए भारत की पहली शहरी सार्वजनिक परिवहन रोपवे परियोजना का निर्माण किस शहर में किया जा रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Varanasi (Uttar Pradesh) is developing India's first public transport ropeway project, spanning 4.2 km between Varanasi Cantt Railway Station and Godowlia Chowk, reducing travel time from 45 minutes to 15 minutes.
• Option A is Incorrect because Haridwar operates tourist ropeways (Mansa Devi/Chandi Devi), not an urban mass transit public ropeway network.
• Option B is Incorrect because Shimla uses ropeways for hill connectivity and tourism rather than a dedicated urban mass transit corridor.
• Option D is Incorrect because Dehradun's ropeway project is planned for Mussoorie connectivity, not as the first urban public transport system.

national_questions.qe: Who became the first Indian woman wrestler to win a gold medal at the Senior World Wrestling Championships?
national_questions.qh: विश्व कुश्ती चैंपियनशिप में स्वर्ण पदक जीतने वाली पहली भारतीय महिला पहलवान कौन बनी हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because Manisha Bhanwala created history by becoming India's first-ever woman wrestler to win a World Championship gold medal, securing top honors in the 59kg freestyle category in Astana, Kazakhstan.
• Option A is Incorrect because Vinesh Phogat has won multiple World Championship bronze medals, but not a gold.
• Option B is Incorrect because Sakshi Malik is an Olympic bronze medalist (2016) but has not won a World Championship gold.
• Option C is Incorrect because Antim Panghal won World Championship bronze medals and U20 World titles, but not senior gold.

national_questions.qe: Which athlete won India's first-ever Youth Olympic Games medal in Wushu at the 2026 Games in Dakar, Senegal?
national_questions.qh: डकार, सेनेगल में आयोजित 2026 यूथ ओलंपिक खेलों में वुशू (Wushu) में भारत का पहला पदक किस एथलीट ने जीता?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Rajkumari Lanchenbi Chanu won bronze in women's changquan combined, securing India's first-ever Youth Olympic medal in Wushu at Dakar, Senegal, where Wushu debuted as a medal discipline.
• Option B is Incorrect because Naorem Roshibina Devi is a senior Asian Games silver medalist in Wushu, not a Youth Olympian.
• Option C is Incorrect because Yumnam Sanathoi Devi is a senior World Championship medalist in Sanda.
• Option D is Incorrect because Pooja Kadian won India's first senior World Wushu Championship gold in 2017.

national_questions.qe: What is the strike range of 'Pralay', the indigenous surface-to-surface quasi-ballistic missile successfully tested by the DRDO off the Odisha coast?
national_questions.qh: डीआरडीओ द्वारा ओडिशा तट से सफलतापूर्वक परीक्षण की गई स्वदेशी सतह-से-सतह पर मार करने वाली क्वासी-बैलिस्टिक मिसाइल 'प्रलय' की मारक क्षमता कितनी है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct: 'Pralay' is a solid-propellant surface-to-surface quasi-ballistic missile developed by Research Centre Imarat (RCI), Hyderabad, with a strike range of 150 to 500 km and a payload capacity of 500 to 1,000 kg.
• Option B is Incorrect: Medium-range ballistic missiles like Agni-I cover ranges around 700 to 900 km.
• Option C is Incorrect: Intermediate-range missiles cover 1,500 to 2,000 km.
• Option D is Incorrect: Long-range systems like Agni-III/IV operate beyond 2,500 km.

national_questions.qe: Which among the following was designated as India's first Biosphere Reserve in 1986?
national_questions.qh: निम्नलिखित में से किसे 1986 में भारत के पहले बायोस्फीयर रिजर्व (जैवमंडल आरक्षित क्षेत्र) के रूप में अधिसूचित किया गया था?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: The Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve, designated in 1986, was India's first Biosphere Reserve. Out of 18 nationally notified Biosphere Reserves in India, 13 are part of UNESCO's World Network of Biosphere Reserves.
• Option A is Incorrect: Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve in Uttarakhand was established later in 1988.
• Option C is Incorrect: Sundarbans Biosphere Reserve in West Bengal was designated in 1989.
• Option D is Incorrect: Gulf of Mannar Biosphere Reserve in Tamil Nadu was designated in 1989.

national_questions.qe: What target has India set for its total installed non-fossil fuel power capacity to be achieved by the year 2030?
national_questions.qh: भारत ने वर्ष 2030 तक कुल गैर-जीवाश्म ईंधन आधारित स्थापित विद्युत क्षमता हासिल करने का क्या लक्ष्य रखा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: India has set a national target of achieving 500 GW of installed non-fossil fuel power capacity by 2030, expecting over $220 billion in investments for renewable energy expansion.
• Option A is Incorrect: 350 GW is close to the current non-fossil fuel installed capacity, which stands at around 310 GW.
• Option B is Incorrect: 400 GW is an intermediate milestone surpassed before reaching the 2030 target.
• Option D is Incorrect: 650 GW exceeds the official non-fossil target set for 2030.

national_questions.qe: India's first private space debris removal and satellite servicing test facility, named 'Base 1', has been inaugurated in which city?
national_questions.qh: 'बेस 1' नामक भारत की पहली निजी अंतरिक्ष कचरा निपटान और उपग्रह सर्विसिंग परीक्षण सुविधा का उद्घाटन किस शहर में किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct: Cosmoserve Space inaugurated India's first private space debris removal and satellite servicing test facility, named 'Base 1', in Hyderabad.
• Option A is Incorrect: Bengaluru is a major space technology hub housing ISRO headquarters, but this specific private test facility was established in Hyderabad.
• Option B is Incorrect: Chennai hosts aerospace startups like Agnikul Cosmos, not Base 1.
• Option C is Incorrect: Thiruvananthapuram houses ISRO's VSSC facility.

national_questions.qe: Which portal has been API-integrated with the Startup India portal by the Office of the Principal Scientific Adviser to enable startups to seamlessly access national scientific R&D infrastructure?
national_questions.qh: प्रधान वैज्ञानिक सलाहकार के कार्यालय द्वारा स्टार्टअप्स को राष्ट्रीय वैज्ञानिक आर एंड डी बुनियादी ढांचे तक सहज पहुंच प्रदान करने के लिए किस पोर्टल को 'स्टार्टअप इंडिया' पोर्टल के साथ API-एकीकृत किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Office of the Principal Scientific Adviser (PSA), in collaboration with DPIIT under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, integrated Startup India with the I-STEM (Indian Science, Technology and Engineering Facilities Map) portal to allow DPIIT-recognized startups direct access to publicly funded scientific equipment and R&D infrastructure.
• Option B is Incorrect because PARAM Porush relates to supercomputer deployments under the National Supercomputing Mission.
• Option C is Incorrect because SPARSH is a web-based system for defense pension administration implemented by the Ministry of Defence.
• Option D is Incorrect because SUGAM is an e-Governance portal of the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) for regulatory approvals of pharmaceuticals.

national_questions.qe: India's first dedicated green methanol bunkering facility, developed under the National Green Hydrogen Mission, has been operationalized at which major port?
national_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय हरित हाइड्रोजन मिशन के तहत विकसित भारत की पहली समर्पित ग्रीन मेथनॉल बंकरिंग सुविधा किस प्रमुख बंदरगाह पर चालू की गई है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because India’s first dedicated green methanol bunkering facility was established at V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority (VOCPA) in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu, with funding support allocated under the National Green Hydrogen Mission.
• Option A is Incorrect because Jawaharlal Nehru Port (JNPT) is India's premier container port located in Maharashtra, but does not host this facility.
• Option C is Incorrect because Visakhapatnam Port is a major port in Andhra Pradesh focusing primarily on bulk cargo handling.
• Option D is Incorrect because Deendayal Port (Kandla) is situated in Gujarat's Gulf of Kutch.

national_questions.qe: Who among the following became the first Indian swimmer to win a medal at the Youth Olympic Games by securing a bronze in the women's 100m freestyle event?
national_questions.qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन युवा ओलंपिक खेलों में महिलाओं की 100 मीटर फ्रीस्टाइल स्पर्धा में कांस्य पदक जीतकर पदक जीतने वाले पहले भारतीय तैराक बने हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Dhinidhi Desinghu created history by winning India's first-ever Youth Olympic Games medal in swimming, securing a bronze medal in the women's 100m freestyle at Dakar 2026 with a national record time of 56.27 seconds.
• Option A is Incorrect because Maana Patel is an Indian Olympic backstroke swimmer, but did not win a Youth Olympic medal.
• Option B is Incorrect because Srihari Nataraj is a leading male backstroke swimmer who represented India at the Olympics.
• Option C is Incorrect because Virdhawal Khade is an Asian Games bronze medalist in butterfly events.

national_questions.qe: India’s first indigenous high-speed train set, named B28, for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail corridor, is being manufactured at which facility?
national_questions.qh: मुंबई-अहमदाबाद हाई-स्पीड रेल कॉरिडोर के लिए बी28 (B28) नाम से भारत की पहली स्वदेशी हाई-स्पीड ट्रेन सेट का निर्माण किस विनिर्माण सुविधा केंद्र में किया जा रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the B28 high-speed train set, India's first indigenous bullet train designed for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail Corridor, is being manufactured at the private ADITYA facility in Bengaluru.
• Option A is Incorrect because Integral Coach Factory (ICF) Chennai is known for manufacturing Vande Bharat semi-high-speed express trains.
• Option B is Incorrect because Rail Coach Factory (RCF) is located in Kapurthala, Punjab, and produces conventional passenger coaches.
• Option C is Incorrect because Modern Coach Factory (MCF) is located in Raebareli, Uttar Pradesh.

national_questions.qe: Under the revised policy framework for the Agnipath Recruitment Scheme, what is the maximum total service period after which Agniveers become eligible for regular soldier enrolment?
national_questions.qh: अग्निपथ भर्ती योजना के संशोधित नीतिगत ढांचे के तहत, कितने वर्षों के कुल सेवा काल के बाद अग्निविर नियमित सैनिक नामांकन के लिए पात्र होते हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: Under the updated policy guidelines, serving Agniveers receive an additional two-year extension beyond their initial 4-year tenure, enabling absorption into regular services after a total of 6 years of service.
• Option A is Incorrect: 4 years was the initial engagement duration defined when the Agnipath scheme was launched in June 2022.
• Option B is Incorrect: 5 years is not the extended service threshold prescribed under the modified policy.
• Option D is Incorrect: 8 years exceeds the total combined engagement timeframe.

national_questions.qe: Which Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) specification lays down the requirements for E20 blend motor gasoline supplied in India?
national_questions.qh: भारत में आपूर्ति किए जाने वाले E20 ब्लेंड मोटर गैसोलीन के लिए भारतीय मानक ब्यूरो (BIS) का कौन सा विशिष्ट मानक लागू होता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Bureau of Indian Standards specification IS 17021 defines the quality standards and statutory parameters for E20 motor gasoline (20% ethanol blended petrol).
• Option A is Incorrect because IS 11656 does not pertain to E20 fuel specifications.
• Option B is Incorrect because IS 15464 relates to anhydrous ethanol used for blending rather than the finished E20 fuel blend.
• Option D is Incorrect because IS 18000 is not the designated specification for E20 fuel.

national_questions.qe: Which academic institution signed a Memorandum of Agreement with the Indian Air Force's Software Development Institute to develop an indigenous secure airborne communication system?
national_questions.qh: स्वदेशी सुरक्षित हवाई संचार प्रणाली विकसित करने के लिए भारतीय वायु सेना के सॉफ्टवेयर डेवलपमेंट इंस्टीट्यूट के साथ किस शैक्षणिक संस्थान ने समझौता ज्ञापन पर हस्ताक्षर किए हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the IAF's Software Development Institute partnered with IIT Madras and IITM Pravartak Technologies Foundation to build indigenous airborne digital communication systems.
• Option B is Incorrect because IIT Bombay is not a party to this agreement.
• Option C is Incorrect because IIT Kanpur is not involved in this specific project.
• Option D is Incorrect because IIT Kharagpur has not signed this MoA with IAF SDI.

national_questions.qe: Which state tennis association became the first in India to formally adopt the National Sports Governance Act, 2025?
national_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय खेल शासन अधिनियम, 2025 को औपचारिक रूप से अपनाने वाला भारत का पहला राज्य टेनिस संघ कौन सा बन गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Karnataka State Lawn Tennis Association (KSLTA) is the first state tennis body in India to adopt the National Sports Governance Act, 2025 via a unanimous resolution.
• Option A is Incorrect because MSLTA is not the first association to adopt the Act.
• Option C is Incorrect because TNTA has not adopted the governance framework first.
• Option D is Incorrect because DLTA was not the pioneer in adopting this Act.

national_questions.qe: In which Turkish city is the 31st UN Climate Change Conference (COP31) being held?
national_questions.qh: 31वें यूएन जलवायु परिवर्तन सम्मेलन (COP31) का आयोजन किस तुर्की शहर में हो रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because COP31 is scheduled in Antalya, Turkey as per the official UNFCCC agenda.
• Option B is Incorrect because Istanbul is not the host city for COP31.
• Option C is Incorrect because Ankara is the capital but not the venue for this summit.
• Option D is Incorrect because Izmir is not selected for COP31.

national_questions.qe: What new scheme allowing Agniveers to join the regular army after two years of service was approved by the Cabinet?
national_questions.qh: कैबिनेट द्वारा स्वीकृत वह नई योजना कौन सी है जो अग्निवीरों को दो वर्ष की सेवा के बाद नियमित सेना में शामिल होने की अनुमति देती है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Cabinet approved the ‘Second Tour of Duty’ scheme for Agniveers.
• Option A is Incorrect; there is no such ‘National Service Scheme’ linked to Agniveers.
• Option C is Incorrect; ‘Army Reserve Integration’ is a different proposal.
• Option D is Incorrect; ‘Veteran Transition Programme’ does not pertain to this policy.

national_questions.qe: According to BIS specification IS 17021, what is the maximum ethanol blending percentage allowed in E20 petrol?
national_questions.qh: BIS मानक IS 17021 के अनुसार E20 पेट्रोल में अधिकतम इथेनॉल मिश्रण प्रतिशत कितना है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because BIS IS 17021 permits ethanol blending up to 20% in E20 petrol, as confirmed by Ministry tests.
• Option A is Incorrect; 15% is below the stipulated range.
• Option B is Incorrect; 18% is below the maximum limit.
• Option D is Incorrect; 22% exceeds the BIS specification for E20.

national_questions.qe: During PM Modi's visit to the CRPF camp in Bastar, what milestone was highlighted regarding CRPF jawan casualties?
national_questions.qh: बस्तर में पीएम मोदी की CRPF कैंप यात्रा के दौरान CRPF जवानों की हताहत न होने की किस अवधि को प्रमुख उपलब्धि के रूप में बताया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Prime Minister noted that for the first time in 47 years, no CRPF jawan lost life on duty.
• Option A is Incorrect; the milestone is not 10 years.
• Option B is Incorrect; the figure is higher than 20 years.
• Option C is Incorrect; the correct period is 47 years, not 30.

national_questions.qe: What does the 'Second Tour of Duty' approved for Agniveers allow?
national_questions.qh: अग्निवीरों के लिए स्वीकृत 'सेकंड टूर ऑफ ड्यूटी' क्या प्रदान करती है?
oe: Agniveers can serve as civilian volunteers after completing two years of service.
Eligible Agniveers may enroll as regular soldiers after a two‑year engagement period.
Agniveers receive a pension after completing one year of service.
Agniveers are granted a scholarship for higher education after two years.
oh: अग्निवीरों को दो वर्ष की सेवा के बाद नागरिक स्वयंसेवक के रूप में कार्य करने की अनुमति।
योग्य अग्निवीरों को दो‑साल की अवधि के बाद नियमित सैनिक के रूप में भर्ती होने की अनुमति।
एक वर्ष की सेवा के बाद अग्निवीरों को पेंशन प्रदान की जाएगी।
दो वर्ष के बाद अग्निवीरों को उच्च शिक्षा के लिए छात्रवृत्ति दी जाएगी।
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Cabinet approved a 'Second Tour of Duty' enabling eligible Agniveers to join the regular cadre after completing the initial two‑year term.
• Option A is Incorrect as the scheme does not convert Agniveers into civilian volunteers.
• Option C is Incorrect; no pension scheme was announced for Agniveers.
• Option D is Incorrect; the policy does not involve scholarships.

national_questions.qe: What is the maximum balance for which EPFO will automatically settle inoperative EPF accounts as announced on its 74th Foundation Day?
national_questions.qh: ईपीएफओ द्वारा 74वें स्थापना दिवस पर घोषित किए गए निष्क्रिय ईपीएफ खातों के स्वचालित निपटान की अधिकतम राशि क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because EPFO announced automatic settlement for eligible inoperative accounts with balances up to Rs 1,000.
• Option B is Incorrect; the threshold is not Rs 1,500.
• Option C is Incorrect; the limit is lower than Rs 2,000.
• Option D is Incorrect; Rs 2,500 exceeds the announced ceiling.

national_questions.qe: Which central armed police force recorded zero on‑duty fatalities for the first time in 47 years, as highlighted by the Prime Minister during the Diwali celebration at the CRPF camp in Karanpur, Bastar?
national_questions.qh: कौन सी केंद्रीय सशस्त्र पुलिस बल ने 47 वर्षों में पहली बार कर्तव्य पर शून्य मौतें दर्ज कीं, जैसा कि प्रधानमंत्री ने करनपुर, बस्तर में सीआरपीएफ कैंप में दीवाली समारोह के दौरान बताया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Prime Minister noted that for the first time in 47 years, no CRPF jawan lost his life on duty, marking a historic safety record in the fight against Left Wing Extremism.
• Option B is Incorrect because the BSF, while a key paramilitary force, was not mentioned in the Prime Minister’s statement regarding zero casualties.
• Option C is Incorrect because the ITBP operates mainly along the Indo‑China border and was not part of the cited achievement.
• Option D is Incorrect because the SSB, responsible for border security with Nepal and Bhutan, was not referenced in the context of the zero‑fatality milestone.

national_questions.qe: Which Union Ministry oversees the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Medical Devices, under which fresh applications were invited with an extended timeline up to FY 2035-36?
national_questions.qh: चिकित्सा उपकरणों के लिए उत्पादन से जुड़ी प्रोत्साहन (PLI) योजना किस केंद्रीय मंत्रालय द्वारा प्रशासित की जाती है, जिसके तहत वित्तीय वर्ष 2035-36 तक की विस्तारित समय सीमा के साथ नए आवेदन आमंत्रित किए गए हैं?
oe: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the PLI Scheme for Medical Devices (PLI-MD) is implemented by the Department of Pharmaceuticals under the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, with an outlay of ₹2,700 crore extended up to 2035-36.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare handles medical device regulatory frameworks, not the industrial PLI scheme.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Ministry of Commerce and Industry oversees general trade and investment promotion.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ministry of Science and Technology handles R&D funding rather than manufacturing PLI schemes.

national_questions.qe: Which Union Ministry organizes the annual 'Shilp Samagam Mela' to provide a national marketing platform for artisans belonging to Scheduled Castes, OBCs, and Persons with Disabilities?
national_questions.qh: अनुसूचित जाति, अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग और दिव्यांगजनों से संबंधित कारीगरों को राष्ट्रीय विपणन मंच प्रदान करने के लिए वार्षिक 'शिल्प समागम मेला' किस केंद्रीय मंत्रालय द्वारा आयोजित किया जाता है?
oe: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
oh: सूक्ष्म, लघु एवं मध्यम उद्यम मंत्रालय
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Shilp Samagam Mela is organized by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment through its apex corporations (NSFDC, NBCFDC, NSKFDC, NDFDC) at Dilli Haat, New Delhi.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Ministry of Textiles organizes general handicraft Expos, whereas Shilp Samagam specifically empowers targeted vulnerable social categories.
• Option B is Incorrect because MSME Ministry focuses on small business policy and micro-entrepreneurship.
• Option D is Incorrect because Rural Development handles SARAS Melas for rural Self-Help Groups.

national_questions.qe: Which city is hosting the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and the 21st East Asia Summit attended by Prime Minister Narendra Modi?
national_questions.qh: प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी द्वारा भाग लिए जाने वाले 23वें आसियान-भारत शिखर सम्मेलन और 21वें पूर्वी एशिया शिखर सम्मेलन की मेजबानी कौन सा शहर कर रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Manila, Philippines hosted the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and the 21st East Asia Summit, representing a vital pillar of India's Act East Policy.
• Option A is Incorrect because Jakarta (Indonesia) hosted earlier editions of the summit.
• Option C is Incorrect because Vientiane (Laos) is not the host city for these specific summit editions.
• Option D is Incorrect because Bangkok (Thailand) is not hosting this official summit round.

national_questions.qe: Under the rationalized visa framework notified by the Ministry of Home Affairs, into how many main categories has the Indian visa regime been consolidated?
national_questions.qh: गृह मंत्रालय द्वारा अधिसूचित युक्तिसंगत वीजा ढांचे के तहत भारतीय वीजा व्यवस्था को कितने मुख्य श्रेणियों में समेकित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Ministry of Home Affairs simplified India's visa framework by reducing main visa categories from 13 down to nine, and sub-categories from 49 to 23.
• Option A is Incorrect because seven is lower than the actual nine consolidated categories.
• Option B is Incorrect because eleven does not reflect the newly streamlined classification.
• Option D is Incorrect because fifteen is higher than the original 13 main categories.

national_questions.qe: From which location was India's first research sounding rocket launched into the upper atmosphere on November 21, 1963?
national_questions.qh: 21 नवंबर 1963 को भारत का पहला अनुसंधान साउंडिंग रॉकेट ऊपरी वायुमंडल के अध्ययन के लिए किस स्थान से प्रक्षेपित किया गया था?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because India's first research sounding rocket (Nike-Apache) was launched from Thumba Equatorial Rocket Launching Station (TERLS) in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, on 21 November 1963.
• Option B is Incorrect because Sriharikota (Satish Dhawan Space Centre) became the primary rocket launch center later in 1971.
• Option C is Incorrect because Wheeler Island (Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Island) in Odisha is utilized by DRDO for missile testing.
• Option D is Incorrect because Pokhran in Rajasthan is famous for India's nuclear test operations.

national_questions.qe: Between which two stations was India's first 'Amrit Bharat 3.0' train flagged off in November 2026?
national_questions.qh: नवंबर 2026 में भारत की पहली 'अमृत भारत 3.0' ट्रेन किन दो स्टेशनों के बीच शुरू की गई?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Indian Railways flagged off the first 'Amrit Bharat 3.0' train operating between New Delhi and Patna, designed specifically with push-pull technology for non-AC and general class travel.
• Option A is Incorrect because Mumbai Central to Ahmedabad is the corridor under development for India's High-Speed Bullet Train.
• Option C is Incorrect because Varanasi to Howrah is served by existing Vande Bharat Express services.
• Option D is Incorrect because Bengaluru to Chennai is a high-density southern Vande Bharat rail route.

national_questions.qe: Which police station is set to become India's first AI-powered police station under a pilot initiative launched by the Telangana Police?
national_questions.qh: तेलंगाना पुलिस द्वारा शुरू की गई एक पायलट पहल के तहत कौन सा पुलिस स्टेशन भारत का पहला एआई-संचालित (AI-powered) पुलिस स्टेशन बनने जा रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Panjagutta Police Station in Hyderabad was chosen as India's first AI-powered police station pilot, integrating automated FIR filing, case diary management, and multilingual 'Setu' kiosks.
• Option A is Incorrect because Cyberabad is a major police commissionerate, not the individual station chosen for this pilot project.
• Option B is Incorrect because Banjara Hills is an adjacent urban jurisdiction but not the selected AI pilot location.
• Option D is Incorrect because Madhapur covers the IT corridor but was not designated for India's first AI police station project.

national_questions.qe: In which event did shooter Niraj Kumar win a bronze medal at the ISSF World Championship in Doha to secure India's first quota for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Games?
national_questions.qh: दोहा में आयोजित आईएसएसएफ (ISSF) विश्व चैंपियनशिप में निशानेबाज नीरज कुमार ने किस स्पर्धा में कांस्य पदक जीतकर लॉस एंजिल्स 2028 ओलंपिक खेलों के लिए भारत का पहला कोटा हासिल किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because Niraj Kumar secured India's first Olympic quota for the LA 2028 Games by winning a bronze medal in the Men's 50m Rifle 3-Positions event at the ISSF World Championship in Doha.
• Option A is Incorrect because 10m Air Rifle Men is a distinct Olympic shooting discipline.
• Option B is Incorrect because 25m Rapid Fire Pistol is a pistol category, whereas Niraj Kumar competes in rifle disciplines.
• Option C is Incorrect because 10m Air Pistol is an air pistol discipline.

national_questions.qe: In which year did India's first metro railway network, the Kolkata Metro, commence its commercial operations?
national_questions.qh: भारत की पहली मेट्रो रेलवे सेवा, कोलकाता मेट्रो, ने किस वर्ष अपना व्यावसायिक परिचालन शुरू किया था?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: Kolkata Metro, India's first underground metro railway system, started its commercial operations on October 24, 1984, on a 3.4-km stretch between Esplanade and Bhowanipore. Later in 2010, it was declared a separate zonal railway (17th Zone) of Indian Railways.
• Option A is Incorrect: 1978 is incorrect as the construction work was ongoing during this period after foundation laying in 1972.
• Option C is Incorrect: 1990 is incorrect; the full initial line from Dum Dum to Tollygunge became fully operational later in 1995.
• Option D is Incorrect: 1998 is incorrect as it predates the launch of Delhi Metro which began in 2002.

bihar_questions.qe: Which organization is responsible for setting up the Space Gallery and Innovation Centre at Darbhanga Planetarium?
bihar_questions.qh: दरभंगा प्लैनेटेरियम में स्पेस गैलरी और इनोवेशन सेंटर स्थापित करने की जिम्मेदारी किस संगठन की है?
oe: National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT)
oh: राष्ट्रीय शैक्षिक अनुसंधान एवं प्रशिक्षण परिषद (NCERT)
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because ISRO experts inspected the site and the project is being executed under ISRO’s technical support.
• Option B is Incorrect because DST is not involved in this space‑related infrastructure.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ministry of Education does not act as the nodal agency for ISRO projects.
• Option D is Incorrect because NCERT focuses on curriculum, not space galleries.

bihar_questions.qe: Under the Tenth Schedule of the Indian Constitution, on which ground does an independently elected member of a Legislative Assembly or Council face disqualification?
bihar_questions.qh: भारतीय संविधान की दसवीं अनुसूची के तहत, किसी विधान सभा या विधान परिषद के निर्दलीय निर्वाचित सदस्य को किस आधार पर अयोग्य घोषित कर दिया जाता है?
oe: If they join any political party after the election
If they abstain from voting in any general legislative session
If they fail to take oath within six months of election
If they form an informal alliance with other independent members
oh: यदि वे चुनाव के बाद किसी राजनीतिक दल में शामिल हो जाते हैं
यदि वे किसी सामान्य विधायी सत्र में मतदान से अनुपस्थित रहते हैं
यदि वे चुनाव के छह महीने के भीतर शपथ लेने में विफल रहते हैं
यदि वे अन्य निर्दलीय सदस्यों के साथ अनौपचारिक गठबंधन बनाते हैं
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because under Article 191(2) and the Tenth Schedule of the Constitution, an independently elected member of a legislature is disqualified if they join any political party after their election.
• Option B is Incorrect because mere absence without whip violation does not attract Tenth Schedule provisions.
• Option C is Incorrect because failure to take oath within six months does not fall under Tenth Schedule anti-defection rules.
• Option D is Incorrect because forming an informal alliance or extending external support without taking formal party membership does not trigger disqualification under the Tenth Schedule.

bihar_questions.qe: What percentage range of India's total makhana (fox nut) production is contributed by the state of Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: भारत के कुल मखाना (फॉक्स नट) उत्पादन में बिहार राज्य का योगदान कितना प्रतिशत है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Bihar accounts for 85% to 90% of India's total makhana production, covering over 35,000 hectares across the Mithilanchal, Seemanchal, and Kosi regions.
• Option A is Incorrect because Bihar's share is significantly higher than 50-55%.
• Option B is Incorrect because 65-70% underestimates Bihar's dominant contribution to national makhana yields.
• Option D is Incorrect because 35-40% is factually inaccurate.

bihar_questions.qe: Under which initiative has an MoU been signed between the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways and the Bihar Government to utilize excavated river silt in National Highway construction?
bihar_questions.qh: सड़क परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय और बिहार सरकार के बीच राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग निर्माण में खोदी गई नदी की गाद (सिल्ट) का उपयोग करने के लिए किस पहल के तहत समझौता ज्ञापन पर हस्ताक्षर किए गए हैं?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways signed an MoU with the Bihar Government to undertake scientific desilting under the 'Nadi Sanjivani' initiative, utilizing silt in ongoing and future National Highway projects.
• Option B is Incorrect because 'Jal-Jeevan-Hariyali' is Bihar's flagship climate resilience and water conservation campaign.
• Option C is Incorrect because 'Setu Bharatam' aims to make all national highways free of railway level crossings.
• Option D is Incorrect because 'Nadi Abhyudaya' is a fictitious name in this context.

bihar_questions.qe: In which sports complex is Bihar's first World Athletics Class-1 synthetic track being constructed?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार का पहला विश्व एथलेटिक्स क्लास-1 सिंथेटिक ट्रैक किस खेल परिसर में निर्मित किया जा रहा है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Bihar is setting up its first World Athletics Class-1 synthetic track at the Pataliputra Sports Complex in Kankarbagh, Patna, jointly developed by the Sports Department and Bihar State Sports Authority.
• Option A is Incorrect because Moin-ul-Haq Stadium is primarily a cricket stadium under redevelopment in Patna.
• Option C is Incorrect because Rajgir Sports Complex recently hosted the Women's Asian Champions Trophy but is not the location for this Class-1 track.
• Option D is Incorrect because Mithilesh Stadium is a police ground located in Gaya.

bihar_questions.qe: Which cultural institution was named the world's most visited museum in 2025 according to the TEA Global Experience Index report?
bihar_questions.qh: टीईए ग्लोबल एक्सपीरियंस इंडेक्स रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, 2025 में दुनिया का सबसे अधिक देखा जाने वाला संग्रहालय कौन सा सांस्कृतिक संस्थान बना?
oe: Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Palace Museum (Forbidden City) in Beijing, China, recorded 19 million visitors in 2025, ranking as the world's most visited museum in the TEA Global Experience Index.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Louvre Museum in Paris recorded 9.05 million visitors, ranking lower on the index.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York did not hold the top position.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Vatican Museums were not ranked as the top visited museum in the report.

bihar_questions.qe: Under the Bihar Renewable Energy Policy 2025, what target capacity has the Bihar government set for renewable energy generation to be achieved by the year 2030?
bihar_questions.qh: 'बिहार नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा नीति 2025' के तहत बिहार सरकार ने वर्ष 2030 तक कितनी नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा उत्पादन क्षमता का लक्ष्य निर्धारित किया है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because under the Bihar Renewable Energy Policy 2025, the state aims to reach 24 GW of renewable energy capacity and 6 GWh of energy storage capacity by 2030.
• Option B is Incorrect because 18 GW is lower than the official policy commitment of 24 GW pitched during the India Renewable Energy Summit 2026.
• Option C is Incorrect because 30 GW exceeds the state's stated target for 2030.
• Option D is Incorrect because 12 GW represents only half of the target capacity approved by the Bihar state government.

bihar_questions.qe: What official National Expressway designation has been assigned to the proposed Patna-Purnia Greenfield Expressway in Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में प्रस्तावित पटना-पूर्णिया ग्रीनफील्ड एक्सप्रेसवे को कौन सा आधिकारिक राष्ट्रीय एक्सप्रेसवे क्रमांक प्रदान किया गया है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the proposed six-lane Patna-Purnia Greenfield Expressway is officially designated as National Expressway-9 (NE-9).
• Option A is Incorrect because NE-5 corresponds to a different highway corridor in the national network.
• Option C is Incorrect because NE-12 is not assigned to the Patna-Purnia stretch.
• Option D is Incorrect because NE-7 does not refer to Bihar's first greenfield national expressway.

bihar_questions.qe: Which state ranked first in the inaugural Ease of Vehicle Ownership Index (EVOI) released jointly by IndiaTech.org and Consumer VOICE?
bihar_questions.qh: इंडियाटेक.ऑर्ग (IndiaTech.org) और कंज्यूमर वॉयस (Consumer VOICE) द्वारा संयुक्त रूप से जारी पहले 'ईज ऑफ व्हीकल ओनरशिप इंडेक्स' (EVOI) में किस राज्य ने शीर्ष स्थान प्राप्त किया है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct: Andhra Pradesh topped the first Ease of Vehicle Ownership Index (EVOI) with a score of 5.91 out of 10 across six operational pillars.
• Option B is Incorrect: Tamil Nadu was evaluated in the 15-state assessment but did not achieve the top rank.
• Option C is Incorrect: Gujarat was not the top performer on the six index pillars.
• Option D is Incorrect: Maharashtra did not secure the overall first rank in this index.

bihar_questions.qe: Under the Viksit Bharat-Rozgar evam Aajeevika Guarantee Mission-Rural (VB-G RAM G) scheme in Bihar, how many days of guaranteed wage employment are provided annually to rural households?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में विकसित भारत-रोजगार एवं आजीविका गारंटी मिशन-ग्रामीण (VB-G RAM G) योजना के तहत ग्रामीण परिवारों को प्रतिवर्ष कितने दिनों के गारंटीकृत मजदूरी रोजगार का प्रावधान किया गया है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: The expanded VB-G RAM G scheme in Bihar guarantees 125 days of rural employment annually per household, supported by an allocation of ₹22,000 crore.
• Option A is Incorrect: 100 days is the standard baseline entitlement under MGNREGA, whereas VB-G RAM G expands this to 125 days.
• Option C is Incorrect: 150 days is applicable only during specific drought/calamity notifications, not the standard target under this scheme.
• Option D is Incorrect: 200 days is not the statutory guarantee provided under VB-G RAM G.

bihar_questions.qe: In which US city did External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar chair a bilateral review meeting with Indian Consuls General serving across the United States?
bihar_questions.qh: विदेश मंत्री एस. जयशंकर ने संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में कार्यरत भारतीय कौंसुल जनरलों के साथ द्विपक्षीय समीक्षा बैठक की अध्यक्षता किस अमेरिकी शहर में की?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: EAM S Jaishankar reviewed diplomatic, trade, and diaspora ties in Atlanta alongside all eight Indian Consuls General serving in the United States.
• Option A is Incorrect: New York hosts an Indian consulate general, but it was not the venue for this overall diplomatic review meeting.
• Option B is Incorrect: Chicago is one of the eight consulate locations, but not the host city for this meeting.
• Option D is Incorrect: San Francisco hosts a consulate general, but the official review meeting took place in Atlanta.

bihar_questions.qe: The Bihar state government announced plans to install the state's tallest statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel in which city?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार सरकार ने किस शहर में सरदार वल्लभभाई पटेल की राज्य की सबसे ऊंची प्रतिमा स्थापित करने की घोषणा की है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct: The Bihar government announced during Rashtriya Ekta Diwas celebrations at Bapu Sabhagar that the state's tallest statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel will be erected in Patna.
• Option A is Incorrect: Gaya was not designated as the venue for this memorial statue.
• Option B is Incorrect: Muzaffarpur is not the selected site for installing the state's tallest Patel statue.
• Option C is Incorrect: Bhagalpur was not chosen for this landmark project.

bihar_questions.qe: Which National Highway in Bihar has been selected by the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) for a pilot trial of a technology-based, barrier-free toll collection system?
bihar_questions.qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग प्राधिकरण (NHAI) द्वारा बिहार में किस राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग को प्रौद्योगिकी-आधारित, बाधा-रहित टोल संग्रह प्रणाली के पायलट परीक्षण के लिए चुना गया है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct: NHAI selected NH-31 in Bihar for an initial trial of an Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) and GPS-linked barrier-free toll collection model.
• Option B is Incorrect: NH-28 is a major east-west highway connecting Barauni to UP border, but not selected for this specific pilot.
• Option C is Incorrect: NH-30 connects Mohania to Bakhtiyarpur, not chosen for the barrier-free pilot trial.
• Option D is Incorrect: NH-57 connects Muzaffarpur to Purnea, not the designated highway for this tolling test.

bihar_questions.qe: Under the Chief Minister Gramin Peyjal Nishchay Yojana in Bihar, what is the revised solar panel capacity mandated for installation on rural water towers?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में 'मुख्यमंत्री ग्रामीण पेयजल निश्चय योजना' के तहत ग्रामीण जल मीनारों पर स्थापित की जाने वाली सौर पैनल क्षमता को बढ़ाकर कितना कर दिया गया है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: The Bihar Chief Minister directed officials to enhance the solar panel capacity on rural water towers from 5 kW to 20 kW under the Chief Minister Gramin Peyjal Nishchay Yojana.
• Option A is Incorrect: 10 kW is lower than the newly mandated 20 kW expansion target.
• Option C is Incorrect: 15 kW is an intermediate value not targeted in this state initiative.
• Option D is Incorrect: 25 kW is incorrect as the specified upgrade is capped at 20 kW.

bihar_questions.qe: Inspired by Maharashtra's 'Buldhana Pattern', which MoU initiative was signed between MoRTH and the Bihar government to use desilted river material for highway construction?
bihar_questions.qh: महाराष्ट्र के 'बुलढाणा पैटर्न' से प्रेरित होकर, राजमार्ग निर्माण के लिए नदियों की गाद (सिल्ट) का उपयोग करने हेतु MoRTH और बिहार सरकार के बीच किस समझौता ज्ञापन (MoU) पहल पर हस्ताक्षर किए गए हैं?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: MoRTH and the Bihar Government signed the MoU titled 'Nadi Sanjivani, Nadi Punarjeevan, Sadak Navnirman' to utilize desilted material from rivers like Ganga, Kosi, and Gandak for highway construction.
• Option A is Incorrect: Jal Nirmaan Yojana is a fictitious title and not the name of the signed MoU.
• Option B is Incorrect: Setu Samriddhi Project is not the initiative framed around highway embankment construction from river silt.
• Option D is Incorrect: Gramin Path Punarjeevan does not represent the official partnership signed with MoRTH.

bihar_questions.qe: Which two digital portals were launched by the Bihar Government to strengthen global diaspora engagement and streamline investor registration?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार सरकार द्वारा वैश्विक प्रवासी समुदाय के जुड़ाव को मजबूत करने और निवेशक पंजीकरण को सुव्यवस्थित करने के लिए किन दो डिजिटल पोर्टलों का शुभारंभ किया गया है?

NRI Bihar Cell and Invest Bihar Portal
Nivesh Mitra Portal and Bihar Samriddhi Portal
Bihar Foundation Portal and Bihar Business Connect-2027 Portal

एनआरआई बिहार सेल और इन्वेस्ट बिहार पोर्टल
निवेश मित्र पोर्टल और बिहार समृद्धि पोर्टल
बिहार फाउंडेशन पोर्टल और बिहार बिजनेस कनेक्ट-2027 पोर्टल
bihar_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct: The Bihar Chief Minister officially launched the 'Bihar Foundation Portal' and 'Bihar Business Connect-2027 Portal' to engage the global Bihari diaspora and optimize investor registrations.
• Option A is Incorrect: 'Bihar Pravasi Portal' and 'Udyog Bihar Portal' are not the official portal names launched at the event.
• Option B is Incorrect: 'NRI Bihar Cell' is an organizational branch and not the digital platform introduced.
• Option C is Incorrect: 'Nivesh Mitra Portal' belongs to Uttar Pradesh, not Bihar's diaspora initiative.

bihar_questions.qe: Between which two major urban centers in Bihar has the state government announced the construction of an 83-km long Ganga riverfront road project?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार सरकार ने किस दो प्रमुख शहरी केंद्रों के बीच 83 किलोमीटर लंबी गंगा रिवरफ्रंट सड़क परियोजना के निर्माण की घोषणा की है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct: The Bihar state government announced an 83-km long Ganga riverfront road project connecting Munger and Bhagalpur to enhance regional transport, spur trade, and assist in flood management along the Ganga basin.
• Option B is Incorrect: Patna and Buxar are not the endpoints for this newly announced 83-km corridor.
• Option C is Incorrect: Begusarai and Khagaria lie along the Ganga basin but are not the terminals of this riverfront road.
• Option D is Incorrect: Bhagalpur and Katihar represent a different regional stretch and are not part of this specific announcement.

bihar_questions.qe: Which NHAI Toll‑Operate‑Transfer (ToT) bundle in Bihar covers the 90.6 km Purnea‑Dalkhola‑Raiganj section of NH‑27?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में कौन सा NHAI टोल‑ऑपरेट‑ट्रांसफर (ToT) बंडल 90.6 किमी पर्निया‑डालखोला‑रायगंज सेक्शन को कवर करता है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the 90.6 km Purnea‑Dalkhola‑Raiganj stretch of NH‑27 is listed under ToT Bundle 22.
• Option B is Incorrect; Bundle 20 refers to the 145.6 km Muzaffarpur‑Darbhanga‑Asanpur section.
• Option C is Incorrect; Bundle 21 covers the 139.3 km Asanpur‑Forbesganj‑Purnea section.
• Option D is Incorrect; Bundle 19 is not mentioned in the bids.

bihar_questions.qe: In which year is the Global Convention on Transforming Bihar scheduled to be held in Patna?
bihar_questions.qh: ग्लोबल कॉन्फ़्रेंस ऑन ट्रांसफ़ॉर्मिंग बिहार किस वर्ष पटना में आयोजित होने के लिए निर्धारित है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the two‑day convention is slated for 12‑13 January 2027.
• Option A is Incorrect; 2025 is not the announced year.
• Option B is Incorrect; 2026 is not the announced year.
• Option D is Incorrect; 2028 is not the announced year.

bihar_questions.qe: The 19‑km six‑lane Kacchi Dargah‑Bidupur bridge over the Ganga connects which two districts in Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: गंगा पर 19 किमी लंबा छह‑लेन कच्ची दरगाह‑बिदुपुर पुल किन दो जिलों को जोड़ता है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the bridge links Kacchi Dargah in Patna district with Bidupur in Vaishali district.
• Option A is Incorrect; Saran district is not part of the alignment.
• Option C is Incorrect; Muzaffarpur district is not involved.
• Option D is Incorrect; Bhagalpur district is not involved.

bihar_questions.qe: How many BlazeX electric motorcycles did Revolt Motors agree to supply to the Bihar Police?
bihar_questions.qh: रिवोल्ट मोटर्स ने बिहार पुलिस को कितनी ब्लेज़एक्स इलेक्ट्रिक मोटरसाइकिलें सप्लाई करने का आदेश दिया?

• Option B is Correct because the institutional order is for 1,100 BlazeX electric bikes.
• Option A is Incorrect; the order is not for 500 units.
• Option C is Incorrect; 2,000 units were not ordered.
• Option D is Incorrect; 1,500 units were not ordered.

bihar_questions.qe: Under the domestic electricity subsidy scheme in Bihar, how many units of subsidised power per month has the state government appealed to income tax payers to voluntarily surrender?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में घरेलू बिजली सब्सिडी योजना के तहत राज्य सरकार ने आयकर दाताओं से प्रति माह कितने यूनिट सब्सिडी वाली बिजली स्वेच्छा से छोड़ने की अपील की है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Bihar State Government spends approximately ₹23,000 crore annually on power subsidies and has appealed to affluent households and income tax payers to voluntarily surrender their entitlement to 125 units of free electricity.
• Option A is Incorrect because 100 units is not the target quantum specified in the Bihar state government's appeal.
• Option C is Incorrect because 150 units exceeds the monthly threshold designated under the subsidy appeal.
• Option D is Incorrect because 200 units is an incorrect limit.

bihar_questions.qe: Which city was conferred the 'State First Clean City' award for Bihar in the 10th edition of Swachh Survekshan?
bihar_questions.qh: स्वच्छ सर्वेक्षण के 10वें संस्करण में बिहार के किस शहर को 'राज्य प्रथम स्वच्छ शहर' (State First Clean City) पुरस्कार से सम्मानित किया गया?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Patna was conferred the 'State First Clean City' award for Bihar in the 10th edition of Swachh Survekshan by President Droupadi Murmu, recognizing the efforts of the Patna Municipal Corporation and public participation.
• Option B is Incorrect because Gaya did not secure the top clean city recognition in this edition.
• Option C is Incorrect because Muzaffarpur was not awarded the top state clean city rank in Swachh Survekshan.
• Option D is Incorrect because Bhagalpur did not win the primary state honor.
